label: 正面宽膝跪坐
pose_lead: Grounded pose, frontal kneel with the knees wide open:
lower_limbs: Both knees open far to each side, the lower legs folded back, the seat settling between the legs.
upper_limbs: Both arms reach straight down, hands placed together on the ground directly in front of the body.
torso_head: The upper body sits almost upright with the shoulders drawn slightly forward; the head faces straight ahead.
weight_silhouette: A highly symmetric composition: the knees form a wide triangular base and the arms a single central vertical.
